title: c1 major DE+QE convergent: emitted recovery tokens exist nowhere in the versioned vocabulary
description: Evidence: repair-registry-artifact (registry/mod.rs:54) and correct-the-write (state/write.rs:31) are hardcoded, unregistered in composition-scope-and-actions' recovery family, contradicting the crate's own loaded-not-hardcoded rule; no fidelity test covers the write side. OPERATOR-SHAPED: registering tokens is a registration act under the maturity gate — the triage choice is register both (vocabulary addition, data+schema pair) with a declared bootstrap-mirror exemption for the registry loader, or rule the write/registry surfaces developer-facing and exempt, recorded. Owner: data-engineer. Validator: solution-owner.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: OPERATOR RULING (2026-07-21): REGISTER BOTH. correct-the-write and repair-registry-artifact enter the composition vocabulary's recovery family — this adoption is the registration act under the maturity gate. Conduct: the write path loads its token from the vocabulary like the read path; the registry loader keeps its hardcoded string as a DECLARED BOOTSTRAP MIRROR (the loader cannot load before loading — the permanent chicken-and-egg), with the in-code exemption note and a fidelity test pinning the constant to the registered member at test time. The E0212-class enforcement covers both the moment they land. Fix pass executes.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: FIX LANDED (commit daacdc84, registration executed per the operator decision): both members in the composition vocabulary with the registering prose note; the write path loads correct-the-write; the loader carries the declared bootstrap mirror; two fidelity tests pin token-to-member on both surfaces. The E0212-class pattern and the vocabulary's schema pair validated the additions at pre-commit. Validator: solution-owner.
